slides.title: Introduction
slides.content:
# FastAPI ⚡

Modern, fast, async API framework!

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

@app.get('/')
async def home():
    return {'message': 'Hello FastAPI!'}

@app.get('/items/{item_id}')
async def read_item(item_id: int):
    return {'item_id': item_id}
```

```bash
uvicorn main:app --reload
```

> 💡 **Auto-generates docs** at `/docs`!

slides.title: Pydantic Models
slides.content:
# Type Validation 📋

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float
    in_stock: bool = True

@app.post('/items')
async def create_item(item: Item):
    return item

# Auto validates!
# POST {"name": "Phone", "price": 999.99}
```

> ✅ **Automatic validation & documentation!**
